Properly placed items earn you reputation, which can be spent on useful skills and upgrades. These help you find and organize goods more quickly, gradually increasing the effectiveness of your market's restoration. You can play solo or with friends, dividing the work between several players and simultaneously exploring different parts of the marketplace. Together, you can quickly find remaining items, tidy up the shelves, and prepare the market for opening.

Features of the game

Search for scattered goods Boxes, shelves and display stands Reputation for skills and upgrades Single and co-op play
